question.worked_solution:
To find the common ratio $r$ of a geometric sequence given two terms ${a}_{m}$ and ${a}_{n},$ we use the formula

$$
{r}^{n-m}=\frac{{a}_{n}}{{a}_{m}}.
$$

In this case, we're given ${a}_{10}=-224$ and ${a}_{5}=7.$ Substituting $n=10$ and $m=5$ into the formula, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{10-5} & =\frac{{a}_{10}}{{a}_{5}} \\ {r}^{5} & =\frac{(-224)}{7} \\ {r}^{5} & =-32.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, by solving the equation for $r,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{5} & =-32 \\ {r}^{5} & =(-2)^{5} \\ r & =-2.\end{aligned}
$$
